explication: Jellyfin Enhanced is a server-installed Jellyfin plugin that adds optional, per-user web-app and server-side features. A viewer uses the enhanced Jellyfin interface; for Seerr requests, the plugin also coordinates with Seerr, while scheduled synchronization and event-driven services support background capabilities. The graph preserves the README’s major feature areas and connects only relationships documented there or visible in indexed source. Several subsystems are represented at directory level because their implementation files were not sampled.
